newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar finishes slightly easier.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar finishes slightly easier.

text.p: Nearby LIFFE white sugar finished Wednesday evening slightly weaker, but off the lows.
May finished 40 cents weaker at $306.00 per tonne after touching a low of $305.60. August ended 20 cents softer at $305.70.
The bulk of volume was in May, which accounted for 1,303 of the total 1,814 lots.
Paris futures ended barely changed and mixed, with May 10 cents firmer at $306.20 and August 20 cents softer at $306.10.
